Rebild is a Danish municipality evaluated in the 2022–2023 annual report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1]. The report assesses clinical quality in atrial fibrillation treatment across all 98 Danish municipalities, utilizing Rebild as one of the data points for local healthcare quality development and benchmarking [^src1]. 

Specifically, Rebild is documented in the calculations for Indicator 5, which tracks the prevention of ischemic strokes (apopleksi) via anticoagulation treatment using data from DanStroke [^src1]. Because the available evidence for Rebild is limited to a single statistical entry in this report, no further details regarding local interventions, historical trends, or related entities are documented in the current corpus.
